## Fukui et al. (2003), 300 K lattice-average BM3

Record: `brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3` · Model: `BM3`

**Outcome: Coefficient parity achieved.**

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization.
**Comparison basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

[Stored EOS coefficients and source](../material-summaries/brucite.md#record-brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3)

### What this result establishes

**Separate source-review status:** primary\_source\_validated.
**Usage recommendation:** Source-checked isotherm at its stated temperature only. This does not validate the full published thermal EOS or an interpolation between temperatures.

- Conditional comparison against individual reported errors using every printed same-temperature row and the source expansion reference volume fixed. Unweighted pressure residuals, not author weights. At 873 K the K0 difference exceeds one reported error and the figure implies inconsistent volume normalization. Lattice-average fit includes H rearrangement; no phase-pure or original-workflow claim.
- Usage recommendation: Source-checked isotherm at its stated temperature only. This does not validate the full published thermal EOS or an interpolation between temperatures.
- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.

### Data and reconstruction method

- **Dataset identifiers:** brucite\_fukui\_2003\_table1; brucite\_fukui\_2003\_table4
- **Observations:** 13
- **Fit kind:** unweighted\_pressure\_residuals\_fixed\_source\_V0
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared

Unspecified selections, weights, fixed values or error conventions remain unknown; they have not been inferred for this report.

### Curves, residuals and fit error

![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3](figures/brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3-curves.svg#only-light)
![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3](figures/brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Fit | Pressure RMS error (GPa) |
| --- | ---: |
| Original / source fit | 0.228 |
| Reconstruction / refit | 0.217 |

Both fits use the same 13 recovered audit input rows. Residual = P(model) − P(input), evaluated at each input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive pressure error, not a parameter uncertainty or the optimizer's weighted/latent-coordinate objective.

**Volume coordinate:** audit volume in record units. **Row selection:** Named source-audit row reader.

Curves use full stored coefficients. For thermal data, separate isotherms are labelled; when there are more than five temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum sampled temperatures are shown. Residuals include every selected row at its own temperature. Coordinate error bars appear only where the row reader can recover all widths; their meaning remains that of the source dataset (including digitization widths). Missing bars do not mean zero error. No uncertainty band is inferred.

### Source versus reconstruction

![Source/target and reconstructed central values for brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3](figures/brucite_fukui_2003_300k_bm3-dark.svg#only-dark)

Display rounding: errors with leading digit 1 or 2 use two significant digits; other errors use one. Each parameter is rounded to the same decimal place as its error. Values without a positive reported error use at most six significant digits; this is a display limit, not an uncertainty estimate. Full precision is preserved in EOSMAT and the numerical ledger. Missing errors mean unknown, not zero. Parameter names and volume conventions follow the named audit; error widths do not imply a confidence convention.
